workflows.label: Context Lifecycle
workflows.summary: Flow from .claude/agents: capture evidence for a target object, fan in to Product KB candidates, build feature profiles/checklists, review independently, then publish only after approval.

agents.label: Context Lifecycle Orchestrator
agents.responsibility: Coordinates the context lifecycle from bootstrap request through explorer fan-out, normalization, profile/checklist build, review, and approved publish.

agents.label: Scope Planner
agents.responsibility: Plans bootstrap or refresh scope by object, role, state, layer, discovery unit, and priority when target scope is broad.
agents.last_event: Not used for explore store config because a concrete target task is already assigned

agents.label: Portal Explorer
agents.responsibility: Captures current portal behavior for a concrete object/environment/role with UI inventory, SCN/ACT action timeline, before/after evidence, and redacted network refs.
agents.last_event: In progress for CTX-20260921-03: raw/portal/portal-evidence.json not yet produced

agents.label: API Explorer
agents.responsibility: Maps captured runtime traces to normalized API operations, request/response shapes, observed statuses, ACT-IDs, and state deltas without inventing endpoints.
agents.last_event: In progress for CTX-20260921-03: intermediate/api/action-api-map.json not yet produced

agents.label: Storefront Explorer
agents.responsibility: Captures customer-facing storefront behavior only when the portal feature has buyer-facing effect, including theme/product/campaign context, personalization, preview, cart boundary, and portal-to-storefront mapping.
agents.last_event: In progress for CTX-20260921-03: raw/storefront/storefront-evidence.json not yet produced

agents.label: Doc Ingest Explorer
agents.responsibility: Extracts cited claims from dev-provided documentation (DOC-ID/DSEC-ID/CLAIM-ID, verbatim quotes) into Documentation Evidence Artifacts during DOC_BOOTSTRAP mode runs.

agents.label: DB Explorer
agents.responsibility: Explores schema and read-only persistence behavior, mapping selected ACT-IDs to entity state deltas when DB observation is enabled.
agents.last_event: Optional for this task unless DB observation is explicitly enabled

agents.label: Code/Config Explorer
agents.responsibility: Answers specific implementation questions from source routes, config, flags, permissions, events, jobs, and integrations without changing code.
agents.last_event: Not called because no specific code/config question is assigned

agents.label: Knowledge Normalizer
agents.responsibility: Fans in portal, storefront, API, DB, code, and doc artifacts into Product KB candidates with provenance, knowledge kind, scope, conflict tracking, and cross-layer ACT-ID mapping.
agents.last_event: Queued for CTX-20260921-03, waiting on explorer evidence

agents.label: Feature Profile Builder
agents.responsibility: Builds feature profiles by user goal/capability from KB candidates with actor, entry point, state, validation, permission, UI/API/data/code mapping, risk, freshness, and coverage.
agents.last_event: Queued for CTX-20260921-03, waiting on Product KB candidate

agents.label: Checklist Builder
agents.responsibility: Creates reusable regression checklist candidates from feature profiles, observed surfaces, risks, and valid oracles.
agents.last_event: Queued for CTX-20260921-03, waiting on feature profiles

agents.label: Knowledge Diff Analyzer
agents.responsibility: Compares candidate KB/profile/checklist with canonical context version 2+ and reports added/changed/refreshed/deprecated/conflicted knowledge plus blast radius.
agents.last_event: Queued for CTX-20260921-03, waiting on checklist candidates

agents.label: Context Quality Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Independently reviews Product KB, Feature Profiles, Checklists, and semantic diff for provenance, knowledge-kind integrity, coverage, redaction, freshness, version consistency, and publish readiness.
agents.last_event: Queued for CTX-20260921-03, waiting on knowledge diff
